# Conversions data_HF -\> Circaetus_gallicus

Attention, tout faire par HF.ID et prendre en compte les différents individus.

## Nouveau tableau

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| include: false
# Fenêtre de lissage pour MA
ma_window <- 5

# Point de référence pour transformer lat/lon en X,Y
ref_lon <- min(data_HF$location.long)
ref_lat <- min(data_HF$location.lat)

# Nouveau tableau
data_HF$HF.ID <- as.factor(data_HF$HF.ID)
Circaetus_gallicus <- data.frame(
  HF.ID = data_HF$HF.ID,
  timestamp = data_HF$timestamp,
  X.m = distGeo(cbind(ref_lon, ref_lat), cbind(data_HF$location.long, ref_lat)),
  Y.m = distGeo(cbind(ref_lon, ref_lat), cbind(ref_lon, data_HF$location.lat)),
  Z.m = data_HF$height.above.ground_GPS,
  ele = data_HF$height.above.ground_GPS,
  lon = data_HF$location.long,
  lat = data_HF$location.lat,
  Species = "Circaetus gallicus",
  individuals = data_HF$individual.local.identifier,
  dtime = data_HF$dtime_new,
  age_group = data_HF$age_group,
  season = data_HF$MIGRATION
)
#summary(data_HF$height.above.ellipsoid_GPS)
#summary(data_HF$height.above.ground_GPS)
#summary(data_HF$height.above.msl_GPS)

# Date_in_unix et only_date
# "origin at the beginning of data belonging to each bird and day"
#### Probmème ici
# Nous il faut que ce soit à partir du début de chaque HF.ID pour chaque individuals.
# Il faut que ce soit : 0.3, 0.6, 0.9, 1.2, 1.5.... (en minute)
Circaetus_gallicus$only_date <- as.Date(Circaetus_gallicus$timestamp)
Circaetus_gallicus <- Circaetus_gallicus %>%
  arrange(HF.ID, timestamp) %>%
  group_by(HF.ID, only_date) %>%
  mutate(
    date_in_unix = as.numeric(difftime(timestamp, min(timestamp), units = "secs"))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
summary(Circaetus_gallicus$date_in_unix)
summary(Circaetus_gallicus$dtime)

# Correction des signes
Circaetus_gallicus$X.m <- ifelse(data_HF$location.long < ref_lon, -Circaetus_gallicus$X.m, Circaetus_gallicus$X.m)
Circaetus_gallicus$Y.m <- ifelse(data_HF$location.lat < ref_lat, -Circaetus_gallicus$Y.m, Circaetus_gallicus$Y.m)
```

## Noyau gaussien et Lissage MA (Moving Average)

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| include: false
# Créer un noyau gossien
gaussian_kernel <- function(n, sigma) {
  x <- seq(-floor(n/2), floor(n/2), length.out = n)
  w <- exp(-x^2 / (2 * sigma^2))
  w / sum(w)
}

# Appliquer le filtre
window_size <- 7 # (2loc avant 2 loc après) tester diff window : 3, 5 et 7
sigma <- 0.8
kernel <- gaussian_kernel(window_size, sigma)

Circaetus_gallicus <- Circaetus_gallicus %>%
  arrange(HF.ID, timestamp) %>%
  group_by(HF.ID) %>%
  mutate(
    X.m._MA = if(n() >= length(kernel)) stats::filter(X.m, kernel, sides = 2) else NA,
    Y.m._MA = if(n() >= length(kernel)) stats::filter(Y.m, kernel, sides = 2) else NA,
    Z.m._MA = if(n() >= length(kernel)) stats::filter(Z.m, kernel, sides = 2) else NA
  ) %>%
  ungroup() # Applique un filtre si il n'y a pas assez de points, met NA



########## Il y a un problème avec Z? => Non mais valeurs très hautes


# Lissage
Circaetus_gallicus$X.m._MA <- rollmean(Circaetus_gallicus$X.m, ma_window, fill = NA, align = "center")
Circaetus_gallicus$Y.m._MA <- rollmean(Circaetus_gallicus$Y.m, ma_window, fill = NA, align = "center")
Circaetus_gallicus$Z.m._MA <- rollmean(Circaetus_gallicus$Z.m, ma_window, fill = NA, align = "center")
```

## Calcul des vitesses et accélérations filtrées

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| include: false
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::lag)
Circaetus_gallicus <- Circaetus_gallicus %>%
  arrange(HF.ID, timestamp) %>%
  group_by(HF.ID, only_date) %>%
  mutate(
    dtime_sec = dtime * 60,

    # MA positions
    X.m._MA = rollmean(X.m, 5, fill = NA, align = "center"),
    Y.m._MA = rollmean(Y.m, 5, fill = NA, align = "center"),
    Z.m._MA = rollmean(Z.m, 5, fill = NA, align = "center"),

    # Vitesses (lag au lieu de diff)
    Vx = (X.m._MA - lag(X.m._MA)) / dtime_sec,
    Vy = (Y.m._MA - lag(Y.m._MA)) / dtime_sec,
    Vz = (Z.m._MA - lag(Z.m._MA)) / dtime_sec,
    Vxy = sqrt(Vx^2 + Vy^2),

    # MA vitesses
    Vx_MA = rollmean(Vx, 5, fill = NA, align = "center"),
    Vy_MA = rollmean(Vy, 5, fill = NA, align = "center"),
    Vz_MA = rollmean(Vz, 5, fill = NA, align = "center"),
    Vxy_MA = sqrt(Vx_MA^2 + Vy_MA^2),

    # Accélérations
    Ax = (Vx_MA - lag(Vx_MA)) / dtime_sec,
    Ay = (Vy_MA - lag(Vy_MA)) / dtime_sec,

    # MA accélérations
    Ax_MA = rollmean(Ax, 5, fill = NA, align = "center"),
    Ay_MA = rollmean(Ay, 5, fill = NA, align = "center"),

    
    
    # K = (Vx * Ay - Vy * Ax) / (Vx^2 + Vy^2)^(3/2) 
    # Courbure du mouvement (virage)
    # gliding: |k| < 0.01 m-1 and vz < 0 m/s, thermalling: |k| > 0.01 m-1 and vz > 0 m/s
    K = (Vx * Ay - Vy * Ax) / (Vx^2 + Vy^2)^(3/2),
    K_MA = rollmean(K, 5, fill = NA, align = "center"),
     ) %>%
  ungroup()


### Ajout colonnes
Circaetus_gallicus$vertical_speed  <- Circaetus_gallicus$Vz_MA
Circaetus_gallicus$horizontal_speed <- Circaetus_gallicus$Vxy_MA
```

```{r}
  mutate(
    Individual = stri_trans_general(
      gsub("_spring_\\d{4}|_autumn_\\d{4}", "", track_ID),

    ),
```

# Visuels et calculs indépendants

```{r}
##### Colonnes catégorielle vol en fonction de K
Circaetus_gallicus1 <- Circaetus_gallicus %>%
  mutate(
    flight_phase = case_when(
      abs(K) < 0.001 & Vz < 0 ~ "gliding", ## Seuils Keskin modifiés (/10)
      abs(K) > 0.001 & Vz > 0 ~ "thermalling",
      TRUE ~ "other"  # flapping, landing, etc.
    )
  )

# Quelle proportion de chaque catégories
# Comptage simple
table(Circaetus_gallicus1$flight_phase)
#    gliding       other thermalling 
#     158037      249165      169184

# Avec pourcentages
table(Circaetus_gallicus1$flight_phase, useNA = "ifany") %>% 
  prop.table() %>% 
  round(3) * 100

# Tableau détaillé par oiseau
Circaetus_gallicus1 %>%
  count(flight_phase, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))

str(Circaetus_gallicus1)



```

# Afiner :

## Méthode seuil temporel

```{r}

Circaetus_gallicus3 <- Circaetus_gallicus1 %>%
  arrange(HF.ID, timestamp) %>%
  group_by(HF.ID) %>%
  mutate(
    is_therm = flight_phase == "thermalling",
    
    # propagation vers l'avant et l'arrière (fenêtre de 5 points)
    therm_forward = zoo::rollapply(is_therm, 5, max, fill = NA, align = "left"),
    therm_backward = zoo::rollapply(is_therm, 5, max, fill = NA, align = "right"),
    
    therm_propag = ifelse(therm_forward == 1 | therm_backward == 1, TRUE, FALSE),
    
    flight_phase_smooth = ifelse(therm_propag, "thermalling", flight_phase)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Métriques thermiques

## Séléction seulement des périodes en journée

```{r}
library(conflicted)
conflict_prefer("select", "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("filter", "dplyr")

# Ajout colonne sunrise & mins_since_sunrise
str(Circaetus_gallicus3)
Circaetus_gallicus3 <- Circaetus_gallicus3 %>%
  mutate(
    timestamp_posix  = as.POSIXct(timestamp, tz = "UTC"),
    only_date_parsed = as.Date(only_date)
  )

# Combinaisons uniques date × lat × lon
sun_keys <- Circaetus_gallicus3 %>%
  select(only_date_parsed, lat, lon) %>%
  distinct()

# Calcul des levers de soleil
sun_times <- getSunlightTimes(
  data = data.frame(
    date = sun_keys$only_date_parsed,
    lat  = sun_keys$lat,
    lon  = sun_keys$lon
  ),
  keep = "sunrise",
  tz   = "UTC"
)

# Ajout du sunrise aux clés
sun_keys <- sun_keys %>%
  bind_cols(sunrise = sun_times$sunrise)

# Join et calcul du temps écoulé
Circaetus_gallicus3 <- Circaetus_gallicus3 %>%
  left_join(sun_keys, by = c("only_date_parsed", "lat", "lon")) %>%
  mutate(
    secs_since_sunrise = as.numeric(difftime(timestamp_posix, sunrise, units = "secs")),
    mins_since_sunrise = secs_since_sunrise / 60
  )

Circaetus_gallicus3$flight_phase_smooth <- as.factor(Circaetus_gallicus3$flight_phase_smooth)


# Garder seulement les lignes au moins 1h après le lever du soleil
# Identifier les HF.ID dont TOUT le track est après 1h du lever
tracks_apres_1h <- Circaetus_gallicus3 %>%
  group_by(HF.ID) %>%
  summarise(
    mins_debut = first(mins_since_sunrise)
  ) %>%
  filter(mins_debut >= 60) %>%
  pull(HF.ID)

# Garder ces tracks complets dans Circaetus_gallicus3_jour
Circaetus_gallicus3_jour <- Circaetus_gallicus3 %>%
  filter(HF.ID %in% tracks_apres_1h)
```

## Exclusion des tracks anomalies de comportement

Exemples :

Mina de Rians : 2023-10-01 14:28:23 -\> 2023-10-01 15:33:23

Mina de Rians : 2024-08-30 11:36:12 -\> 2024-08-30 12:31:45

Aupsie : 2025-03-09 17:01:09 -\> 2025-03-09 18:03:15

Aupsie : 2025-09-24 13:14:10 -\> 2025-09-24 14:12:55

```{r}
# Sinuosité = distance totale / déplacement net
# Une valeur proche de 1 = vol directionnel (migration)
# Une valeur élevée = vol tortueux (forage, exploration)

sinuosite <- Circaetus_gallicus3_jour %>%
  group_by(HF.ID) %>%
  summarise(
    ID              = first(individuals),
    timestamp_debut = first(timestamp),
    timestamp_fin   = last(timestamp),
    duree_mins      = as.numeric(difftime(last(timestamp), first(timestamp), units = "mins")),
    dist_totale     = sum(sqrt(diff(X.m)^2 + diff(Y.m)^2), na.rm = TRUE),
    dist_nette      = sqrt((last(X.m) - first(X.m))^2 + (last(Y.m) - first(Y.m))^2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(duree_mins >= 30) %>%
  mutate(
    sinuosite = dist_totale / dist_nette
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(sinuosite))

sinuosite
summary(sinuosite$sinuosite)
hist(sinuosite$sinuosite, 
     breaks = 50,
     main = "Distribution de la sinuosité des tracks",
     xlab = "Sinuosité (dist totale / dist nette)")

# Exculsion des tracks dont la sinuosité est > 2.3

# Identifier les HF.ID à exclure
tracks_a_exclure <- sinuosite %>%
  filter(sinuosite > 2.3) %>%
  pull(HF.ID)

cat("Nombre de tracks exclus :", length(tracks_a_exclure), "\n")

# Filtrer Circaetus_gallicus3_jour
Circaetus_gallicus3_jour <- Circaetus_gallicus3_jour %>%
  filter(!HF.ID %in% tracks_a_exclure)

cat("Nombre de tracks restants :", n_distinct(Circaetus_gallicus3_jour$HF.ID), "\n")
```

## Comptage nombre thermique sur tracks individuels HF.ID

```{r}
conflict_prefer("lag", "dplyr")

## Comptage des thermiques
# 0 ou 1 thermique : HF.ID = 2047 6> 0?
# 16 thermiques : HF.ID = 2208
# 6 thermiques : HF.ID = 2212


## subset_HF.ID
subset_HF.ID <- Circaetus_gallicus3[Circaetus_gallicus3$HF.ID == 69, ]
nrow(Circaetus_gallicus3[Circaetus_gallicus3$HF.ID == 69, ])

# Étape 1 : phase_merged (absorber other isolés)
subset_HF.ID <- subset_HF.ID %>%
  arrange(timestamp) %>%
  mutate(
    phase_clean = ifelse(is.na(as.character(flight_phase_smooth)), "other",
                         as.character(flight_phase_smooth)),
    prev_phase = lag(phase_clean),
    next_phase = lead(phase_clean),
    phase_merged = case_when(
  phase_clean == "other" & prev_phase == "thermalling" & next_phase == "thermalling" ~ "thermalling",
  TRUE ~ as.character(phase_clean)
)
    )

# Étape 2 : absorber aussi les blocs "gliding" COURTS entre deux thermalling
n_glide_max <- 30  # seuil à ajuster — blocs gliding de moins de n points sont absorbés

subset_HF.ID <- subset_HF.ID %>%
  mutate(
    block_id_temp = cumsum(phase_merged != lag(phase_merged, default = first(phase_merged)))
  )

blocks_temp <- subset_HF.ID %>%
  group_by(block_id_temp, phase_merged) %>%
  summarise(n_points = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(block_id_temp) %>%
  mutate(
    prev_phase = lag(phase_merged),
    next_phase = lead(phase_merged),
    # Gliding court entre deux thermalling → absorbé
    absorb = phase_merged == "gliding" & 
             n_points <= n_glide_max & 
             prev_phase == "thermalling" & 
             next_phase == "thermalling"
  )

# Appliquer l'absorption au dataframe
subset_HF.ID <- subset_HF.ID %>%
  left_join(blocks_temp %>% select(block_id_temp, absorb), by = "block_id_temp") %>%
  mutate(
    phase_final = ifelse(absorb, "thermalling", phase_merged)
  )

# Étape 3 : blocs finaux
subset_HF.ID <- subset_HF.ID %>%
  mutate(
    block_id = cumsum(phase_final != lag(phase_final, default = first(phase_final)))
  )

# Étape 4 : comptage
n_min <- 36

blocks <- subset_HF.ID %>%
  group_by(block_id, phase_final) %>%
  summarise(
    start_time = min(timestamp),
    end_time   = max(timestamp),
    n_points   = n(),
    .groups    = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(block_id) %>%
  mutate(
    prev_phase = lag(phase_final),
    next_phase = lead(phase_final)
  )

thermals <- blocks %>%
  filter(
    phase_final == "thermalling",
    n_points >= n_min,
    prev_phase %in% c("gliding", "other", NA),
    next_phase %in% c("gliding", "other", NA)
  )


## Enlève les ascendances de moins de 130m "faux thermiques"

# Calcul des gain d'altitudes par thermiques
thermals <- blocks %>%
  filter(phase_final == "thermalling") %>%
  # Joindre les données brutes pour calculer dZ par bloc
  left_join(
    subset_HF.ID %>%
      group_by(block_id) %>%
      summarise(
        dZ        = max(Z.m) - min(Z.m),          # gain d'altitude brut
        dZ_net    = last(Z.m) - first(Z.m),        # gain net (début → fin)
        mean_Vz   = mean(Vz, na.rm = TRUE),        # vitesse verticale moyenne
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "block_id"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    n_points  >= n_min,
    dZ_net    >= 20,     # gain net minimum en mètres — à calibrer
    mean_Vz   >= 0,      # vitesse verticale moyenne positive
    prev_phase %in% c("gliding", "other", NA),
    next_phase %in% c("gliding", "other", NA)
  )

# Retrait des thermiques avec des gains < 130m

thermals <- blocks %>%
  filter(phase_final == "thermalling") %>%
  left_join(
    subset_HF.ID %>%
      group_by(block_id) %>%
      summarise(
        dZ      = max(Z.m) - min(Z.m),
        dZ_net  = last(Z.m) - first(Z.m),
        mean_Vz = mean(Vz, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "block_id"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    n_points  >= n_min,
    dZ_net    >= 130,    # élimine la majorité des faux positifs
    mean_Vz   >= 0.5,    # élimine les blocs à faible ascendance
    prev_phase %in% c("gliding", "other", NA),
    next_phase %in% c("gliding", "other", NA)
  )

# Affichage du compte
cat("Nombre de thermiques :", nrow(thermals), "\n")
thermals



## Représentation du track HF.ID

end_date   <- max(thermals$end_time)

#### Autre méthode avec prise en compte du gain d'altitude 


library(tidyr)
######
subset_HF.ID <- Circaetus_gallicus3[Circaetus_gallicus3$HF.ID == 48, ]

# Seuils
n_min_thermal <- 12   # 36 sec = 12 points à 3s/pt
n_gap_max     <- 20   # 60 sec = 20 points — interruption absorbée si < ça

# Étape 1 : phase_clean
subset_HF.ID <- subset_HF.ID %>%
  arrange(timestamp) %>%
  mutate(
    phase_clean = ifelse(is.na(as.character(flight_phase_smooth)), "other",
                         as.character(flight_phase_smooth))
  )

# Étape 2 : blocs bruts
subset_HF.ID <- subset_HF.ID %>%
  mutate(
    block_id_temp = cumsum(phase_clean != lag(phase_clean, default = first(phase_clean)))
  )

# Étape 3 : résumé des blocs bruts
blocks_temp <- subset_HF.ID %>%
  group_by(block_id_temp, phase_clean) %>%
  summarise(n_points = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(block_id_temp) %>%
  mutate(
    # Identifier les blocs thermalling
    is_thermal = phase_clean == "thermalling",
    # Numéroter les groupes de blocs entre deux thermalling
    thermal_group_before = cumsum(is_thermal),
    thermal_group_after  = rev(cumsum(rev(is_thermal)))
  )

# Calculer la taille totale du gap (other + gliding combinés) entre deux thermalling
gap_sizes <- blocks_temp %>%
  filter(!is_thermal) %>%
  group_by(thermal_group_before) %>%
  summarise(
    gap_total_points = sum(n_points),
    gap_phases       = paste(phase_clean, collapse = "+"),
    # Vérifier qu'il y a bien un thermalling de chaque côté
    has_thermal_after = any(thermal_group_after > 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    absorb_gap = gap_total_points < n_gap_max & has_thermal_after
  )

# Joindre l'info d'absorption sur les blocs
blocks_temp <- blocks_temp %>%
  left_join(
    gap_sizes %>% select(thermal_group_before, absorb_gap),
    by = "thermal_group_before"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    absorb = !is_thermal & replace_na(absorb_gap, FALSE)
  )

# Étape 4 : appliquer l'absorption
subset_HF.ID <- subset_HF.ID %>%
  left_join(blocks_temp %>% select(block_id_temp, absorb), by = "block_id_temp") %>%
  mutate(
    phase_final = ifelse(absorb, "thermalling", phase_clean)
  )

# Étape 5 : blocs finaux
subset_HF.ID <- subset_HF.ID %>%
  mutate(
    block_id = cumsum(phase_final != lag(phase_final, default = first(phase_final)))
  )

# Étape 6 : résumé des blocs finaux
blocks <- subset_HF.ID %>%
  group_by(block_id, phase_final) %>%
  summarise(
    start_time = min(timestamp),
    end_time   = max(timestamp),
    n_points   = n(),
    .groups    = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(block_id) %>%
  mutate(
    prev_phase = lag(phase_final),
    next_phase = lead(phase_final)
  )

# Étape 7 : thermiques valides
thermals <- blocks %>%
  filter(
    phase_final == "thermalling",
    n_points    >= n_min_thermal,
    prev_phase  %in% c("gliding", "other", NA),
    next_phase  %in% c("gliding", "other", NA)
  )


## Enlève les ascendances de moins de 130m "faux thermiques"

# Calcul des gain d'altitudes par thermiques
thermals <- blocks %>%
  filter(phase_final == "thermalling") %>%
  # Joindre les données brutes pour calculer dZ par bloc
  left_join(
    subset_HF.ID %>%
      group_by(block_id) %>%
      summarise(
        dZ        = max(Z.m) - min(Z.m),          # gain d'altitude brut
        dZ_net    = last(Z.m) - first(Z.m),        # gain net (début → fin)
        mean_Vz   = mean(Vz, na.rm = TRUE),        # vitesse verticale moyenne
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "block_id"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    n_points  >= n_min,
    dZ_net    >= 20,     # gain net minimum en mètres — à calibrer
    mean_Vz   >= 0,      # vitesse verticale moyenne positive
    prev_phase %in% c("gliding", "other", NA),
    next_phase %in% c("gliding", "other", NA)
  )

# Retrait des thermiques avec des gains < 130m

thermals <- blocks %>%
  filter(phase_final == "thermalling") %>%
  left_join(
    subset_HF.ID %>%
      group_by(block_id) %>%
      summarise(
        dZ      = max(Z.m) - min(Z.m),
        dZ_net  = last(Z.m) - first(Z.m),
        mean_Vz = mean(Vz, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "block_id"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    n_points  >= n_min,
    dZ_net    >= 130,    # élimine la majorité des faux positifs
    mean_Vz   >= 0.3,    # élimine les blocs à faible ascendance
    prev_phase %in% c("gliding", "other", NA),
    next_phase %in% c("gliding", "other", NA)
  )
```

# Nombre de thermiques par heure : Avec tous les tracks \> 30min

Attention si on change ce seuil il faut également le modifier dans l'exclusion des tracks sinueux

```{r}
# Fonction qui compte les thermiques pour un HF.ID donné
compter_thermiques <- function(data, n_glide_max = 5, n_min = 36) {
  
  data <- data %>%
    arrange(timestamp) %>%
    mutate(
      phase_clean  = ifelse(is.na(as.character(flight_phase_smooth)), "other",
                            as.character(flight_phase_smooth)),
      prev_phase   = lag(phase_clean),
      next_phase   = lead(phase_clean),
      phase_merged = case_when(
        phase_clean == "other" & prev_phase == "thermalling" & next_phase == "thermalling" ~ "thermalling",
        TRUE ~ phase_clean
      ),
      block_id_temp = cumsum(phase_merged != lag(phase_merged, default = first(phase_merged)))
    )
  
  blocks_temp <- data %>%
    group_by(block_id_temp, phase_merged) %>%
    summarise(n_points = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(block_id_temp) %>%
    mutate(
      prev_phase = lag(phase_merged),
      next_phase = lead(phase_merged),
      absorb = phase_merged == "gliding" &
               n_points <= n_glide_max &
               prev_phase == "thermalling" &
               next_phase == "thermalling"
    )
  
  data <- data %>%
    left_join(blocks_temp %>% select(block_id_temp, absorb), by = "block_id_temp") %>%
    mutate(
      phase_final = ifelse(absorb == TRUE, "thermalling", phase_merged),
      block_id    = cumsum(phase_final != lag(phase_final, default = first(phase_final)))
    )
  
  blocks <- data %>%
    group_by(block_id, phase_final) %>%
    summarise(n_points = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(block_id) %>%
    filter(phase_final == "thermalling", n_points >= n_min)
  
  return(nrow(blocks))
}


tableau_thermiques <- Circaetus_gallicus3_jour %>%
  group_by(HF.ID) %>%
  summarise(
    ID                   = first(individuals),
    timestamp_debut      = first(timestamp),
    timestamp_fin        = last(timestamp),
    duree_mins           = as.numeric(difftime(last(timestamp), first(timestamp), units = "mins")),
    mins_depuis_lever    = first(mins_since_sunrise),
    n_thermiques         = compter_thermiques(pick(everything())),
    .groups              = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(duree_mins >= 30) %>%
  mutate(thermiques_par_heure = n_thermiques / duree_mins * 60) %>%
  arrange(ID, timestamp_debut)

tableau_thermiques

cat("Moyenne thermiques/heure :", round(mean(tableau_thermiques$thermiques_par_heure), 2), "\n")
cat("SD :", round(sd(tableau_thermiques$thermiques_par_heure), 2), "\n")
```

# Gain d'altitude par thermique et durée

```{r}
decrire_thermiques <- function(data, n_glide_max = 5, n_min = 36) {
  
  data <- data %>%
    arrange(timestamp) %>%
    mutate(
      phase_clean  = ifelse(is.na(as.character(flight_phase_smooth)), "other",
                            as.character(flight_phase_smooth)),
      prev_phase   = lag(phase_clean),
      next_phase   = lead(phase_clean),
      phase_merged = case_when(
        phase_clean == "other" & prev_phase == "thermalling" & next_phase == "thermalling" ~ "thermalling",
        TRUE ~ phase_clean
      ),
      block_id_temp = cumsum(phase_merged != lag(phase_merged, default = first(phase_merged)))
    )
  
  blocks_temp <- data %>%
    group_by(block_id_temp, phase_merged) %>%
    summarise(n_points = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(block_id_temp) %>%
    mutate(
      prev_phase = lag(phase_merged),
      next_phase = lead(phase_merged),
      absorb = phase_merged == "gliding" &
               n_points <= n_glide_max &
               prev_phase == "thermalling" &
               next_phase == "thermalling"
    )
  
  data <- data %>%
    left_join(blocks_temp %>% select(block_id_temp, absorb), by = "block_id_temp") %>%
    mutate(
      phase_final = ifelse(absorb == TRUE, "thermalling", phase_merged),
      block_id    = cumsum(phase_final != lag(phase_final, default = first(phase_final)))
    )
  
  thermals <- data %>%
    group_by(block_id, phase_final) %>%
    summarise(
      individuals   = first(individuals),
      start_time    = min(timestamp),
      end_time      = max(timestamp),
      start_alt     = first(Z.m),
      end_alt       = last(Z.m),
      gain_altitude = end_alt - start_alt,
      duration_sec  = as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "secs")),
      n_points      = n(),
      .groups       = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      prev_phase = lag(phase_final),
      next_phase = lead(phase_final)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      phase_final == "thermalling",
      n_points    >= n_min,
      prev_phase  %in% c("gliding", "other", NA),
      next_phase  %in% c("gliding", "other", NA)
    )
  
  return(thermals)
}

# Appliquer sur tous les tracks >= 30 min  ← seul changement
age_lookup <- Circaetus_gallicus3_jour %>%
  select(HF.ID, age_group) %>%
  distinct()
thermals_all <- Circaetus_gallicus3_jour %>%
  group_by(HF.ID) %>%
  mutate(duree_mins = as.numeric(difftime(last(timestamp), first(timestamp), units = "mins"))) %>%
  filter(duree_mins >= 30) %>%
  group_by(HF.ID) %>%
  group_modify(~ decrire_thermiques(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(age_lookup, by = "HF.ID")


cat("Gain altitude moyen (m) :", round(mean(thermals_all$gain_altitude, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
cat("SD gain altitude :", round(sd(thermals_all$gain_altitude, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
cat("Durée moyenne (sec) :", round(mean(thermals_all$duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
cat("SD durée :", round(sd(thermals_all$duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")

table(thermals_all$age_group, useNA = "always")
```

```{r}
# En LOG

     log(abs(thermals_all$gain_altitude) + 1)

## Disagnostic des résidus

library(lme4)
library(performance)

#### Extraction des résidus et valeurs ajustées ####
res_gt2 <- residuals(lme_gt2_log)
fitted_gt2 <- fitted(lme_gt2_log)

#### 1. Normalité des résidus ####
# Histogramme
hist(res_gt2, breaks = 30, main = "Distribution des résidus", xlab = "Résidus")

# QQ-plot
qqnorm(res_gt2, main = "QQ-plot des résidus")
qqline(res_gt2, col = "red", lwd = 2)

#### 2. Homogénéité de la variance (homoscédasticité) ####
plot(fitted_gt2, res_gt2,
     xlab = "Valeurs ajustées", ylab = "Résidus",
     main = "Résidus vs valeurs ajustées")
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)
```

```{r}
str(thermals_all)

# lme
lme_duration1 <- lmer(duration_sec  ~ age_group + season + (1|individuals), data = thermals_all)
summary(lme_duration1)
lme_duration2 <- lmer(duration_sec  ~ age_group + season + (1|individuals) + age_group:season, data = thermals_all)
summary(lme_duration2) # Pas de singular fit

AIC(lme_duration1, lme_duration2) # 
summary(lme_duration2)
r2(lme_duration2) # Random effect OK


# Représentation lme
#####

library(ggeffects)
library(ggplot2)

# Effets prédits
pred <- ggpredict(lme_duration2, terms = c("season", "age_group"))
new_data <- as.data.frame(pred)
colnames(new_data)[colnames(new_data) == "x"]     <- "season"
colnames(new_data)[colnames(new_data) == "group"] <- "age_group"

# Valeurs R²
r2_cond <- 0.009
r2_marg <- 0.005
#r2_label <- paste0("Marginal R² = ", r2_marg, " | Conditional R² = ", r2_cond)

new_data$season_num <- ifelse(new_data$season == "autumn", 0, 0.22)
thermals_all$season_num <- ifelse(thermals_all$season == "autumn", 0, 0.22)

ggplot(new_data, aes(x = season_num, y = predicted,

           width = 0.16,

                   labels = c("≥ 5 yrs", "≤ 3 yrs")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.22),
                      labels = c("Autumn", "Spring"),
                      limits = c(-0.1, 0.32)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10)) +   # <- plus de graduations
  labs(

  )
```

# % variation

```{r}
library(officer)
library(flextable)
library(dplyr)

make_ft <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::select(season, adult, juvenile, variation_percent, variable) %>%
    flextable() %>%
    autofit() %>%
    theme_vanilla() %>%
    bold(part = "header")
}

doc <- read_docx()

# Tableau 1 : Age effect on thermal variables
var_age_thermals <- bind_rows(
  var_age_nb_ther %>% mutate(variable = "Number of thermals"),
  var_age_alt_gain_ther  %>% mutate(variable = "Altitude gain per thermal"),
  var_age_time_ther    %>% mutate(variable = "Thermal durations")
)

doc <- body_add_par(
  doc,
  "Age-related variation in flight performance variables",
  style = "heading 1"
)

doc <- body_add_flextable(
  doc,
  value = make_ft(var_age_thermals)
)


print(
  doc,
  target = "C:/Users/alrodrigues/Documents/M2 AMU/STAGE M2/Figures/variation_age_thermals.docx"
)
```
